title: Real Estate Committee Report
summary: 22 homes are currently on the market, priced from 57K to 239K, with 7 homes sold in June averaging at $97.5K. Six orientations were held in June for potential buyers.
_full_body:

22 homes currently on market, prices range from 57K to 239K  
3 homes - contract pending - 2 homes - under contract
